curation.notes: AFM-SMFS (JPK ForceRobot) of the human Izumo1:Juno sperm-egg adhesion complex, with constant-speed (800–6400 nm/s) and force-clamp modes, revealing a multi-state catch bond; constructs site-specifically immobilized via ybbR/Sfp and SpyTag/SpyCatcher with ELP linkers and ddFLN4 fingerprint. Includes point mutants (e.g. infertility-associated JunoH177Q), mouse orthologs, steered MD and Monte Carlo simulations; flow-cytometry bead binding used for KD.
